text:
emma.design: Quick sync — want feedback on the trace viewer drilldown copy + a11y nits. Posting a short list of issues and proposed copy.
raj.engineering: thanks! Paste the list here and I'll flag implementation concerns.
olivia.product: Quick context: PM goal is to make drilldowns discoverable for support and make exports unambiguous for audits.
emma.design: 1) Copy: the top action currently says `Export`. Propose `Download trace` with a chevron for options `CSV (full) / CSV (errors only) / JSON`. 2) Correlation ID: show as monospace hash + small copy icon with tooltip `Copy ID`. Tooltip should say `Copied correlation ID` after click. 3) Stack traces: prefer inline collapsible for short traces, but open long traces in a modal titled `Full stack trace` with code font and wrap.
mike.runtime: Implementation note: loading full stack traces for large traces can be expensive. Suggest lazy fetch when user clicks `Show full stack`. For CSV export, stream the CSV instead of assembling in memory. Also provide a `curl` example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/traces/abcd1234/export?format=csv" > trace.csv`
jordan.a11y: A11Y checklist: - Ensure `Download trace` and export options are keyboard reachable; - When modal opens, trap focus and set `aria-labelledby` to "Full stack trace"; - Stack frames should be announced, e.g., "Frame 3 of 12", use `role=list` + `role=listitem` for frames; - Toasts should use `role=status` so screen readers read "Copied correlation ID". Also contrast for the chip (`#6b7280` on white is borderline) — bump to meet 4.5:1.
raj.engineering: UX question: do we want correlation IDs to be clickable links that open the drilldown in a new tab, or open inline? Clicking new tab avoids heavy in-page state changes. Open tab also makes it easier to share a permalink.
olivia.product: prefer new tab with permalink + preserve current filters in the URL query string. Also add a small link icon that opens in new tab, separate from copy button.
emma.design: UI micro-copy tweaks: - Change header `Trace` -> `Trace details` to avoid confusion with aggregated traces list. - For empty stack traces show `No stack trace available` instead of `-`. - Export dropdown label: `Download trace (all events)` and `Download only error events` (for auditors).
mike.runtime: For large traces we should show a lightweight summary in the drilldown top: `Errors: 3 • Avg latency: 120ms • Instances: auth, api-gateway`. The `Show full stack` button then fetches frames. Also add `Copy stack to clipboard` action for support.
jordan.a11y: Modal dismissal: Escape must close, close button must have `aria-label="Close full stack trace"`. Avoid relying on colour alone to indicate error severity — add icon + text.
raj.engineering: Small perf/UX tradeoff: expand/collapse should animate but be quick. We should cap inline frames shown to 5, with `Show X more frames` link.
emma.design: Copy clarifications: change CSV header `correlation_id` -> `Correlation ID`, `service_name` -> `Service`, `latency_ms` -> `Latency (ms)`. That helps auditors who open CSVs in Excel.
olivia.product: Also request that export filenames are predictable: `trace-<correlation_id>-20260310.csv` (date in YYYYMMDD).
mike.runtime: Backend: add endpoint `GET /traces/:id/export?format=csv&scope=errors|all` and support `Range` param for huge traces. We'll document rate-limits.
emma.design: Accessibility keyboard flow proposal: Tab lands on first action (Copy ID), Tab again to Open in new tab, Tab to Download, then to timeline. Provide visible focus ring that meets contrast.
jordan.a11y: Consider adding quick keyboard shortcut `t` to jump to timeline and `s` to open stack modal when focused on a trace page (announce shortcuts in footer with `aria-hidden` false when focused).
olivia.product: One last thing — change the in-list affordance: correlation ID should be truncated visually (e.g., `abcd1…f9c3`) but on hover show full ID and copy button. Truncation helps maintain row density.
raj.engineering: I'll sketch up the REST proto changes and a minimal wireframe. Emma, can you update the Figma with the modal and inline collapsed views and include keyboard flow?
emma.design: Yep, will update Figma and push a new frame by EOD. Thanks everyone for the quick takes :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: design review doc pushed to #design-reviews.
raj.engineering: I'll follow up with a short tech proposal and list of accessible patterns to implement.
emma.design: Perfect — after that we can lock copy and ship to staging for QA."
